thesis: The engine has re-bought Chainlink at 11.431, five days after stopping out of it at 11.72 for a $37.45 loss - the largest single loss on the book. The adoption story is intact and ETF flows keep arriving, but volatility is expanding rather than coiling and ATR of 5.9% is the widest in the book. Re-entering the name that just took the biggest loss needs better evidence than 'the story is still good'.
bull_case:
Pattern analyst: setup is a **recovery attempt** - close 11.626, 17.5% below the 252-day high, RSI 53, 63d momentum +47.4%, the second highest in the book, with price back above the level it was stopped out at. Verdict: pattern says wait for a close above 11.86, the position's own high.

Institutional flows continue: Chainlink ETFs took $5.36M across 9-10 September, cumulative net inflows are $147.49M since launch and total net assets across both products have reached $181.76M. The integration list is unchanged and substantial - Bottomline bringing CCIP to 600+ banks handling over $16T in annual payments, Circle's wrapped bitcoin using Chainlink Proof of Reserve, Schwab adding LINK. Today's packet gives it the highest news tone in the book at +0.80, and one outlook targets $15+.
bear_case: Squeeze of **1.31** says volatility is expanding, not winding up, which is the wrong structure for a base - and ATR of 5.9% is the widest in the book, so the stop sits 16% below spot and the position is small relative to the risk it carries. This is the same name that ran to 13.455 on 7 September and then fell four straight sessions into a stop at 11.72; the whale distribution that drove it - 2.41M LINK, about $26M, into Coinbase over three weeks - was never reported as having stopped. Two binaries land in two days. Macro, once for the day: the FOMC decides Wednesday 16 September and the odds are genuinely contested - Kalshi showed 48% for a 25bp hike while another tracker had the market-implied probability at 83%, so the single most consequential number this week is one nobody agrees on. The CLARITY Act reaches a Senate vote tomorrow, 15 September, on a revised bill with White House-backed ethics concessions. On energy, Iran and Oman have agreed a **temporary** shipping route lasting two to four months that explicitly does not constitute a full reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. Own backtest (research/backtests/2026-09-06.md): the crypto sleeve returned -6.4%, Sharpe -0.15, 17% win rate over 75 trades. Desk record (research/outcomes.json): 11 closed trades, 0 wins, -$148.09 realised, expectancy -2.84% per trade; long memos are now 3 good of 7 judged, a 0.43 hit rate - below a coin flip. The one long memo the engine acted on, NVDA on 6 September, was stopped out at -8.5%. Conviction is capped accordingly and nothing today is written above 0.65.
catalysts: Continued CLNK ETF inflows beyond $147.49M cumulative
risks: Squeeze 1.31: volatility expanding on a name just stopped out
ATR 5.9%, the widest in the book
Whale distribution never reported as having ceased
Cost the book $37.45 five days ago
Own backtest: 17% win rate in the crypto sleeve
invalidation: The pattern analyst's level is **9.72**, the trailing stop carried in the packet - 16% below spot, which is itself a reason to size small. A close below it ends this. It flips long on a close above 11.86 with ETF inflows continuing.
